```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(flextable)
library(here)

# Raw per-iteration results from 04_run_simulation.R:
#   res_boot_alt, res_boot_null, res_boot_errors, truth_scenarios,
#   scenario_configs, N_BOOT, N_TRIAL, TAU, RATIO_CONTROLS, N_REGISTRY, ALPHA
load(here("results/results_raw_100.RData"))
source(here("functions/load_functions.R"))

group_vars <- c("scenario", "analysis_label", "registry_n", "method")
N_LEVELS   <- as.character(N_REGISTRY)

# Sign convention (Tables 4, A4, A5 and Figure 1): benchmark errors are shown
# as their contribution to the bias of the treatment effect, i.e. with the
# sign flipped (-SE, -ME): positive = treatment effect overestimated.

relabel <- function(df) {
  df |>
    mutate(
      scenario   = factor(recode(scenario, !!!SCENARIO_LABELS),
                          levels = unname(SCENARIO_LABELS)),
      registry_n = factor(registry_n, levels = N_LEVELS)
    )
}
```

```{r summaries}
# Performance measures with Monte Carlo SE.
# alternative -> bias, RMSE, decomposition, power; null -> type I error.
table_main_alt  <- summarise_main_results(res_boot_alt,  group_vars = group_vars, alpha = ALPHA)
table_main_null <- summarise_main_results(res_boot_null, group_vars = group_vars, alpha = ALPHA)
table_balance   <- summarise_balance_results(res_boot_alt, group_vars = group_vars)

# Rejection rates side by side (no MCSE), used by Figure 2
get_reject <- function(df, suffix) {
  df |>
    select(all_of(group_vars), starts_with("reject_"), -ends_with("_mcse")) |>
    rename_with(\(x) paste0(x, suffix), starts_with("reject_"))
}

table_oc <- left_join(
  get_reject(table_main_alt,  "_power"),
  get_reject(table_main_null, "_t1e"),
  by = group_vars
)
```

# Simulation parameters and integrity checks

```{r params}
tibble::tibble(
  Parameter = c("Iterations per scenario", "Trial sample size", "Landmark time \u03c4 (months)",
                "Matching ratio (1:k)", "Significance level \u03b1 (one-sided)"),
  Value     = c(N_BOOT, N_TRIAL, TAU, RATIO_CONTROLS, ALPHA)
) |>
  flextable() |>
  autofit()
```

Iterations that crashed (excluded from all summaries): **`r nrow(res_boot_errors)`**.

```{r integrity}
# Cells with fewer valid replicates than N_BOOT: degenerate matching
# (non-estimability) is a reportable result, not a nuisance.
table_main_alt |>
  filter(n_valid < N_BOOT) |>
  select(scenario, registry_n, method, n_valid, prop_failed) |>
  relabel() |>
  arrange(scenario, registry_n, method) |>
  flextable() |>
  autofit() |>
  set_caption("Cells with fewer than N_BOOT valid replicates (alternative setting).")
```

# Table 3 — True estimands

```{r table3}
# theta_true = log S0*(scenario) / log S0*(S0): the oracle scenario S0 is the
# unfiltered superpopulation, i.e. the population the registry represents.
S0_oracle <- truth_scenarios$S0_true_tau[truth_scenarios$scenario == "S0"]

truth_scenarios |>
  transmute(
    scenario, S0_true_tau, S1_true_tau, deltaS_true,
    RMST0_true, RMST1_true, deltaRMST_true,
    median_surv0_tau, median_surv1_tau,
    theta_true = log(S0_true_tau) / log(S0_oracle),
    delta_true = log(theta_true)
  ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
  setNames(c("Scenario", "S\u2080(t)*", "S\u2081(t)*", "\u0394S(t)*",
             "RMST\u2080*", "RMST\u2081*", "\u0394RMST*",
             "Median\u2080", "Median\u2081", "\u03b8 true", "\u03b4 true")) |>
  flextable() |>
  autofit() |>
  set_caption("Table 3. True estimands by scenario, computed on the latent event times of the scenario-specific trial pools.")
```

```{r effect-table-fun}
# Table 4 (Delta S) and Table A5 (Delta RMST) share the same layout.
make_effect_table <- function(df, e = c("deltaS", "deltaRMST"), caption) {
  e      <- match.arg(e)
  k      <- if (e == "deltaS") "S" else "RMST"
  d_mcse <- if (e == "deltaS") 4 else 3
  sym    <- if (e == "deltaS") "\u0394S(t)" else "\u0394RMST"
  col    <- \(...) df[[paste0(...)]]

  tab <- tibble::tibble(
    scenario     = df$scenario,
    registry_n   = df$registry_n,
    method       = recode(df$method, !!!METHOD_LABELS),
    n_sim        = df$n_valid,
    true         = col("true_", e),
    naive        = col("mean_", e, "_registry"),
    bias_naive   = fmt_est_mcse(col("total_bias_", e, "_naive"),   col("bias_", e, "_registry_mcse"), 3, d_mcse),
    rmse_naive   = fmt_est_mcse(col("rmse_", e, "_registry"),       col("rmse_", e, "_registry_mcse"), 3, d_mcse),
    se           = -col("registry_selection_error_", k),
    matched      = col("mean_", e, "_matched"),
    bias_matched = fmt_est_mcse(col("total_bias_", e, "_matched"), col("bias_", e, "_matched_mcse"),  3, d_mcse),
    rmse_matched = fmt_est_mcse(col("rmse_", e, "_matched"),       col("rmse_", e, "_matched_mcse"),  3, d_mcse),
    me           = -col("matching_error_", k)
  ) |>
    relabel() |>
    arrange(scenario, registry_n, method) |>
    mutate(across(c(true, naive, se, matched, me), \(x) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 3)))

  names(tab) <- c("Sc", "N", "M", "N (sim)", paste0(sym, "*"),
                  paste(sym, "Naive"), "Total bias Naive", paste0("RMSE (", sym, ") Naive"),
                  "Registry selection error (SE)",
                  paste(sym, "Matched"), "Total bias Matched", paste0("RMSE (", sym, ") Matched"),
                  "Matching error (ME)")

  tab |> flextable() |> autofit() |> set_caption(caption)
}
```

# Table 4 — Estimated effect and bias, ΔS(12)

```{r table4}
make_effect_table(
  table_main_alt, "deltaS",
  "Table 4. Estimated survival treatment effect and bias at t = 12 months, naive and matched benchmarks. MCSE in parentheses. SE and ME shown as contribution to bias."
)
```

# Figure 1 — Benchmark error

```{r fig1, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 12}
bias_registry <- table_main_alt |>
  distinct(scenario, registry_n, registry_selection_error_S) |>
  transmute(scenario, registry_n, estimator = "Naive registry",
            bias = -registry_selection_error_S)

bias_matched <- table_main_alt |>
  transmute(scenario, registry_n,
            estimator = recode(method, prop = "Propensity matched", prog = "Prognostic matched"),
            bias = -matching_error_S)

bind_rows(bias_registry, bias_matched) |>
  relabel() |>
  mutate(estimator = factor(estimator,
                            levels = c("Propensity matched", "Prognostic matched", "Naive registry"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = registry_n, y = bias, fill = estimator)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.80), width = 0.70) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ scenario, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Propensity matched" = "#E69F00",
                               "Prognostic matched" = "#56B4E9",
                               "Naive registry"     = "#666666")) +
  labs(x = "Registry size (N)",
       y = "Benchmark error, contribution to bias in \u0394S(12)",
       fill = "") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position  = "bottom",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9))
```

# Figure 2 — Operating characteristics

```{r fig2, fig.height = 8, fig.width = 12}
plot_lr <- table_oc |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(ends_with("_power"), ends_with("_t1e")),
               names_to = "estimand", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(
    metric    = if_else(str_ends(estimand, "_power"), "Power", "Type I error"),
    test_raw  = str_remove(estimand, "_(power|t1e)$") |> str_remove("^reject_"),
    test_type = case_when(str_detect(test_raw, "one_sample") ~ "One-sample LR",
                          str_detect(test_raw, "two_sample") ~ "Two-sample LR"),
    benchmark = case_when(
      # NB: "two_sample_naive" does not match "registry" -> dropped below,
      # as in the original figure (only the one-sample registry curve is shown)
      str_detect(test_raw, "registry")                      ~ "Registry",
      str_detect(test_raw, "matched") & method == "prop"    ~ "Propensity matched",
      str_detect(test_raw, "matched") & method == "prog"    ~ "Prognostic matched"
    ),
    curve  = paste(benchmark, test_type, sep = ": "),
    metric = factor(metric, levels = c("Type I error", "Power"))
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(benchmark), !is.na(test_type)) |>
  # registry curves do not depend on the matching method: keep one copy
  distinct(scenario, registry_n, metric, curve, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  relabel()

ref_lines <- tibble::tibble(
  metric = factor(c("Type I error", "Power"), levels = c("Type I error", "Power")),
  yref   = c(ALPHA, 0.80),
  lty    = c("dashed", "dotted")
)

ggplot(plot_lr, aes(x = registry_n, y = value, group = curve,
                    colour = benchmark, linetype = test_type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_hline(data = tibble::tibble(metric = factor("Type I error", levels = c("Type I error", "Power")),
                                   yref = ALPHA),
             aes(yintercept = yref), linetype = "dashed", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(data = tibble::tibble(metric = factor("Power", levels = c("Type I error", "Power")),
                                   yref = 0.80),
             aes(yintercept = yref), linetype = "dotted", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(metric ~ scenario) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Registry"           = "#666666",
                                 "Prognostic matched" = "#56B4E9",
                                 "Propensity matched" = "#E69F00")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)) +
  labs(x = "Registry size (N)", y = "Probability", colour = "", linetype = "",
       caption = paste0("Dashed line: nominal type I error (\u03b1 = ", ALPHA, "). ",
                        "Dotted line: target power (0.80).")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
